description: Fetch Product Hunt's current Top reviewed Best Products ranking for a required top-level or subcategory slug. Returns one upstream page of up to 15 products with source pagination and yearly snapshot metadata; use --detailed true for descriptions, dates, ratings, categories, images, and maker details. Product Hunt login is not required.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Required Product Hunt top-level or subcategory slug from list-categories, for example productivity or ai-meeting-notetakers.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based upstream result page. Product Hunt currently returns 15 ranked products per page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of products to return from the selected page; integer from 1 through 15.

parameters.name: detailed
parameters.description: Return additional JSON-LD and card metadata. Pass true or false; default false.
